data_rules: Check exact/decoded/gain-normalized duplicates against all2356 existing recordings
Report unresolved excerpt/transcode/pretraining overlap; do not equate no exact duplicates with proven independence
Keep human interval labels distinct from flight metadata; background labels are not independently verified negative stretches
Exclude only invalid/corrupt audio; preserve short/silent input as explicit outcomes
No threshold tuning or normalization changes; no default promotion
Report source results separately; do not pool one-source groups into independent confidence claims
event_metrics: Unassessed unless entire original timing and audible positive/negative truth are established; interval reconstruction cannot recreate missing negative gaps.
purpose: Frozen external recording assessment and separately predeclared human-annotated feasibility task
representative_errors: First2 false negatives and first2 false positives per source/model by sorted original ID; also one correctly detected drone and correct negative where present.
selection: Existing default, non-neural SVM, both repaired frequency CNN seeds. No fresh scores used in selection.

small_task.data: ITU interval-disjoint split supplied by publisher; train/development/test groups kept intact, no overlapping samples cross splits
small_task.label_limit: Two human annotators, reported kappa0.5869; backgrounds came from unlabelled stretches. Exported labels omit individual disagreements and do not establish perfect audibility truth.
small_task.model: Train-only standardized uniform-Hz log-spectral temporal mean/std descriptors plus recording-balanced L2 logistic classifier; C=1, seed42, no hyperparameter sweep. Recording-level multiple-instance target, not positive labels on every crop.
small_task.scope: Within-session published-label feasibility only, not a field-validation benchmark
small_task.selection: Predeclared threshold0.5, no assessment-driven threshold selection; report class counts, group outcomes and ranking

fpv.selection: All37 publisher WAVs. Folder presence labels are weak, unknown sessions collapse to one conservative group.

itu.selection: All eligible contiguous intervals reconstructed only across sample-verified50% overlaps. One source session;35 manually annotated positive intervals; background block identity is not an independent session. Never bridge gaps.

stop_rule: Once errors inform subsequent optimization, label that assessment consumed; obtain a new capture condition for a future reliability claim.
